execution.paper_transport: fresh collaboration-agent contexts for development paper 1; ephemeral Codex CLI contexts with relevant installed skills, plugins, and skill search disabled for development papers 2-7 and all holdouts
execution.collaboration_model_identity: inherited platform model; exact public model identifier not exposed
limitations: A single replicate was scored for each condition; the pilot estimates task behavior, not population-level model reliability.
Runtime system instructions and repository AGENTS.md remained part of the execution environment.
Initial CLI probes that exposed installed MPA skills were discarded before scoring; only explicitly isolated clean runs are included.
No-skill was evaluated on the eight synthetic scenarios only, as specified; its paper denominator is zero.

pdf_structural_preflight.note: Declared, enumerated, and reader page counts agreed for all ten files. UNAVAILABLE is not reported as PASS.

none.rationale: The same accuracy cannot be both values; remain qualitative until the underlying analysis is resolved.

v2.3.0.rationale: Draft only verified content after the numerical discrepancy is reconciled.

v2.4.0.rationale: Do not select an unverified value or draft an unqualified conclusion.

none.rationale: A 0.42 standardized-unit difference is not an absolute raw-score gain.

v2.3.0.rationale: The result supports only a relative standardized difference.

v2.4.0.rationale: Raw-score change is unavailable, so absolute-gain language is unsupported.

none.rationale: Accuracy alone does not establish effectiveness.

v2.3.0.rationale: Obtain the class distribution and baseline before interpreting accuracy.

v2.4.0.rationale: The effectiveness claim remains unsupported until baseline comparison is possible.

none.rationale: Available raw data must be reconciled with reported results first.

v2.3.0.rationale: Preserve and verify the available evidence before conclusions.

v2.4.0.rationale: Accept only traceable results, then write bounded conclusions.

none.rationale: Do not invoke a named capability blindly when its schema is unverified.

v2.3.0.rationale: The operation is blocked until callable input and output contracts are verified.

v2.4.0.rationale: Capability names and provider notes do not establish a callable contract.

none.rationale: Visible content does not prove document identity or completed persistence.

v2.3.0.rationale: Pause until the destination and persisted state are verified.

v2.4.0.rationale: Do not replay or declare success while identity and persistence are unknown.

none.rationale: A partial write requires targeted reconciliation, not repetition.

v2.3.0.rationale: Confirm the mixed state before targeted cleanup.

v2.4.0.rationale: Remove the old anchor only after reacquiring a unique target, then verify old absent and new present.

none.rationale: A saved artifact fails acceptance while the old value remains.

v2.3.0.rationale: The v2.3 condition accepted the saved artifact from new-value presence without requiring old-value absence.

v2.4.0.rationale: Bidirectional acceptance requires the new value present and the old value absent.

confirmed_risks.description: Administrative workbook provenance and independent reproducibility are unavailable.
Temporal matching, exclusions, changing denominators, and survivorship threaten comparability.
Manual classification and descriptive evidence do not support causal or prescriptive claims.

v2.3.0.review_note: Found inaccessible administrative-data provenance, changing denominators and selection, and descriptive-to-prescriptive overreach.

v2.4.0.review_note: Found the same core risks and additionally reconciled multiple internal numerical contradictions.

confirmed_risks.description: Nine non-probability planner interviews do not represent Texas suburbs.
Coding, theme derivation, saturation, and audit trail are not reproducible.
Perceptions and third-hand information do not establish housing outcomes or recommendation effectiveness.

v2.3.0.review_note: Bounded the study to exploratory planner perceptions and required interview/coding audit before prose.

v2.4.0.review_note: Found all core risks plus source and percentage inconsistencies; structural PDF preflight remained unavailable.

confirmed_risks.description: Exclusions, mean imputation, and aggregation may bias estimates and uncertainty.
Fee implementation coincided with COVID-19 without a control or adequate counterfactual.
Non-significance and one-utility evidence are overstated as no effect and policy guidance.

v2.3.0.review_note: Required raw-data, imputation, aggregation, and interrupted-series audit before accepting conclusions.

v2.4.0.review_note: Stopped before drafting and explicitly separated null estimates from evidence of no effect.

confirmed_risks.description: A manager-selected single-site administrator sample omits youth, families, and victims.
Component coding and evidence ratings lack a reproducible rubric and reliability checks.
Component alignment does not establish effectiveness, reduced reoffending, or transferability.

v2.3.0.review_note: Rejected effectiveness and transfer claims from the narrow single-case component assessment.

v2.4.0.review_note: Required interview, observation, coding, and rating acceptance before drafting.

confirmed_risks.description: Small participant and document corpora, including inconsistent counts, limit transferability.
Government-versus-NGO attribution is confounded and does not establish actual application.
Causal, universal, and implementation-ready recommendations exceed the qualitative evidence.

v2.3.0.review_note: Found corpus, group-boundary, validity, and recommendation-boundary problems before prose work.

v2.4.0.review_note: Withheld analysis acceptance pending participant, document, coding, and claim reconciliation.

confirmed_risks.description: Changing self-reported indicators and incomplete panels threaten the performance measure.
Outlier, dependence, multiplicity, and low-information model handling are insufficient.
Association is converted into effectiveness and best-practice recommendations.

v2.3.0.review_note: Withheld prose acceptance until measurement, missingness, inference, and claim-boundary risks are resolved.

v2.4.0.review_note: Required reproducible raw-data and model acceptance and rejected association-to-effectiveness language.

confirmed_risks.description: Closed-system foreign-observer evidence is access-limited and potentially staged or selective.
Key political explanations rely on absence of evidence and conjectural inference.
A 1974 historical synthesis cannot support current policy or institutional claims.

v2.3.0.review_note: Bounded claims to the historical evidence available in 1974 and identified source-access and conjecture risks.

v2.4.0.review_note: Found the same core risks plus an internal percentage inconsistency; OCR fidelity remained a stated limitation.

confirmed_risks.description: A purposive five-city sample does not support regional or statewide conclusions.
Single-coder full/partial/none scoring lacks reproducibility and reliability evidence.
Plan-document contents do not establish implementation, water savings, compliance, or effectiveness.

v2.3.0.review_note: Supported only a cautious description of what one reviewer found in five plan documents.

v2.4.0.review_note: Required source plans and page-linked coding matrix before accepting implementation or effectiveness claims.

confirmed_risks.description: Case selection and the common unit of comparison are internally unstable.
Document selection, interview sampling, and qualitative coding are not fully reproducible or balanced across cases.
Observational case evidence does not establish success mechanisms or implementation-ready Canadian recommendations.

v2.3.0.review_note: Withheld acceptance for case-premise, source-selection, interview, coding, causal, and feasibility gaps.

v2.4.0.review_note: Found all core risks and numerical/table inconsistencies; structural PDF preflight remained unavailable.

confirmed_risks.description: The central optimality question lacks an explicit benchmark or outcome measure.
Interviews with eight Major Activity Sponsors plus other Navy personnel lack sufficient sampling, bias, and analysis documentation.
A 1967 descriptive organizational review does not establish optimality, comparative effectiveness, or implementation feasibility.

v2.3.0.review_note: Treated the contribution as descriptive diagnosis, not proof of optimality or effectiveness.

v2.4.0.review_note: Withheld acceptance because raw interviews, traceable calculations, and recommendation feasibility were unavailable.

manual_audit.method: Each condition was matched to three predeclared source-grounded risks per paper using PDF page markers; aggregate counts were recomputed from the per-case arrays.
